items.title: Show HN: EchoChain to see what happens when LLMs play telephone
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN Community!
I created `echoChain` to explore the following phenomenon: how much data retained after LLMs exchange responses multiple times?
Imagine the game of telephone but with AIs. Each model converts the response into a question, which is then answered. After several rounds, facts get mutated, details get stripped, and the answer is far removed from the initial one.

items.contentSnippet:
Simply close your eyes and imagine the scene you hear. Like if you hear "moonlight on a white flower", imagine that scenario until you hear the next one.
Session duration is also not too long (7 minutes default, you may change the session duration in settings). You may also use it to easily break nightly doomscrolling habit.
Personal experience: I almost always get sleepy eyes after doing it. Share your experience too!

items.title: Show HN: CheckOwners to find your repo's hidden single points of failure
items.contentSnippet:
Hey HN Community!
I created checkOwners to solve a problem by many engineering teams: who knows your codebase, and what will happen when they go away?
This is an open-source, local-first tool which performs analysis based on Git history in order to find hidden knowledge risk in repositories.
It is able to recognize true experts, recognize out-of-date ownership definitions, find knowledge bottlenecks, propose review candidates, and model what would happen when contributors go away.

items.contentSnippet:
Hi HN! We built nonce, an open-source tool that sits between personal AI agents (Muse, Grok, ChatGPT, Claude) and your personal data in Gmail, Calendar, Drive and more.
